name: io.github.ni-c/opengist-mcp
title: Opengist
description: Read, create, update and delete gists on a self-hosted Opengist instance

environmentVariables.name: OPENGIST_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Opengist instance, e.g. https://gist.example.com

environmentVariables.name: OPENGIST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Opengist Personal Access Token (starts with og_), created under Settings -> Access Tokens

environmentVariables.name: OPENGIST_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to not register any write tools (create, update, delete, fork, like)

environmentVariables.name: OPENGIST_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept self-signed TLS certificates (scoped to the Opengist connection)

environmentVariables.name: OPENGIST_ALLOW_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)

environmentVariables.name: OPENGIST_DENY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever OPENGIST_ALLOW_TOOLS left
